about: The lab's findings as filed, copied from its one source (FINDINGS.json in ALEMBIC Mark 2). make_lab.js draws every chart from this file and refuses to print a figure it does not hold.

pools.question: Do swing highs and lows pull price to them?
pools.window: 5 minute gold, 2 Jan 2020 to 30 Jun 2025; the same from 1 Jul 2025 to 30 Oct 2026

channel.question: Does a channel's 2 deviation wall hold?
channel.window: 5 minute gold, the line over 50 closes, 2 Jan 2020 to 30 Jun 2025; recent 1 Jul 2025 to 30 Oct 2026

speeds.question: Does the slow half of a trend read the day better than the fast half?

speeds.definition: the slow half (the tide): the 26 average over or under the 60; the fast half (the wave): the 12 over or under the 26; legs about a day long: a zigzag on 5 minute gold turning after 25 mean bar moves, drawn after the fact from the same closes; the control: the same 5 minute candles put in random order inside each 17:00 to 17:00 New York day, the first candle kept first, 200 series, seed 23112026
speeds.bar: 3 points above the shuffled candles, on both cells and both windows (P-001, the lab's control Q-015 of 23 Nov 02:00)

stack.question: Does a turn pay more with every bigger clock behind it?
definitions: the turn: the chart's own 40 candle average changing direction, on 5 minutes; the stack: the 23 hour, 8 hour, 2 hour and 40 minute clocks all behind the turn; ahead in each of three stretches of years

coil.question: Does a squeeze on gold come before a bigger move?
coil.definition: a squeeze: the last 12 candles' high to low in the lowest tenth of every 12 candle range on that clock over the trailing 365 days, past only; the read: the next 12 candles' high to low against the median 12 candle range from the same slot of the day over the trailing 365 days
coil.atr_line: EDGE in ATRs, the coils' median over the slot-matched baseline median (R&D, 22 Nov 02:3x). Say it as: in ATRs every cell reads the move after a squeeze bigger, 1.05 to 1.14; on the hour's usual range every cell reads it smaller, 0.58 to 0.73. Never: it would have passed.
coil.bar: 1.10 on both windows on both clocks
